requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to Technical Office) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access), internal communication between staff and maintainers, citizen notifications (email/push), anonymous reporting options, and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: See similar story for citizen
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to create a new report through a Telegram bot
So that I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area.
constraints:
Allows the citizen to open a new report by selecting a location on the Turin map, entering a title, description, choosing a category, and attaching up to three photos. The bot also asks if the report should be anonymous.

Example command:

/newreport → Starts the guided process to create a new issue report with location, title, description, category, photos, and anonymity preference.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to check my report status through a Telegram bot 
So that I can quickly get updates.
constraints:
Check the status of their own reports, receiving an updated list with any changes.
Example commands:

/myreports → Lists all your submitted reports with their current status.

/reportstatus 12345 → Shows details and current status of report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly get updates

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive real-time push notifications via the Telegram bot 
So that I know instantly when my report status changes.
constraints:
Example commands:

/subscribe → Enable real-time notifications for all your reports.

/unsubscribe → Disable notifications.

/subscribe report 12345 → Subscribe only to updates for report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I know instantly when my report status changes

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office depending on the problem category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once approved, accepted reports immediately become visible on the Participium portal (map and table).
Unregistered users can view reports on maps but cannot submit new reports.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
An anonymous user's name is still visible to staff and only hidden in the Turin map of reports for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator.
Each maintainer should have their own individual account.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Comments/information exchanged between a technical office and an external maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter).
Case 2 (External maintainer no access): Communication is out of scope; technical office updates status externally.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Notifications/messages can be set to either be sent in real time or when the page is refreshed, depending on user preference.
Public statistics are visible to unregistered users; private statistics are for administrators only.
edge_cases: External maintainer resolves a report assigned to them (Case 1).
Technical office staff member updates status when external company has no access (Case 2).
User zooms out on map to see cumulative report grouping.
User filters table by category, status, or period of time before downloading CSV.
Citizen follows a report that is not closed.
Telegram bot handles commands for help, contacts, and FAQ.
System handles the 30-minute expiration of the registration confirmation code.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the initial review body before assignment.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their configuration panel.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in the user's configuration panel.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters statistics refer to the most active reporters based on report count.
Unregistered users can view reports but cannot interact with them (no comments, no status updates).
Staff members can send messages to citizens which citizens can reply to, implying a chat-like interface within the platform.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports without any authentication headers or cookies. Verify that the response contains a list of reports where the 'status' is 'Approved'. Ensure that the response includes map-compatible data (e.g., coordinates) and that no sensitive fields (like full user names for anonymous users) are exposed in a way that violates domain rules.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality for unregistered users to view public data as per requirement PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Ensure a valid session exists for an 'external_maintainer' role. Perform a PATCH request to /reports/{reportId}/status with a new status value (e.g., 'In Progress'). Verify that the status is updated successfully and that the response reflects the change.
setup_needed: Create a valid session for role 'external_maintainer'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: No cleanup required for status updates; the state change is the intended outcome.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability of external maintainers to update report statuses per PT25.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer.
strategy_items.prompt: Ensure a valid session exists for a 'technical_office_staff_member' role. Perform a POST request to /reports/{reportId}/assign-external with an invalid external maintainer ID (e.g., non-existent or null). Verify that the API returns an appropriate error status code (e.g., 400 Bad Request) indicating that the assignment failed due to the invalid target.
setup_needed: Create a valid session for role 'technical_office_staff_member'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify that no unintended side effects occurred; ensure the report was not assigned to anyone.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures the system handles invalid external maintainer IDs gracefully and does not allow assignment to non-existent users.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports without authentication. Verify that the response filters out reports that are not in 'Approved' status (e.g., 'Pending Approval', 'Assigned'). Ensure that the response does not include sensitive information such as full user names for anonymous users, adhering to domain rules.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the filtering logic to ensure only approved reports are visible and sensitive data is hidden for unregistered users.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer.
strategy_items.prompt: Ensure a valid session exists for a 'technical_office_staff_member' role. First, create a new report via POST /reports. Then, perform a POST request to /reports/{reportId}/assign-external with a valid external maintainer ID. Verify that the assignment is successful and that the report's state transitions correctly (e.g., from 'Pending Approval' to 'Assigned').
setup_needed: Create a valid session for role 'technical_office_staff_member'.
POST /reports to create a new report.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{reportId} if it was not successfully assigned, or verify that the assignment operation did not leave the system in an inconsistent state.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the dependency between creating a report and assigning it to an external maintainer, ensuring proper state transitions.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path registration. Send a POST request to /citizen/signup with valid JSON containing 'name' and 'username'. Ensure the response indicates successful creation or returns a session token/confirmation ID.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core entry point for new users as defined in PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path verification. First, ensure a user exists (via PT01 setup). Send a POST request to /citizen/verify with the correct 'code' and 'username'. Verify the account status changes to active.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 (signup) to create a user record.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the state transition from unverified to verified as per PT27 and domain rules.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges internal notes on a report.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path for internal note exchange. First, create a report (via PT01 signup + PT27 verify + POST /reports). Then, send a POST request to /reports/{reportId}/internal-notes with valid JSON content as a technical office staff member.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 (signup) to create a user.
Execute PT27 (verify) to activate the user.
POST /reports with valid data to create a report resource.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was created; otherwise verify no resource exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the internal communication workflow for staff as per PT26 and domain rules regarding report-specific notes.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a stateful workflow test. First, create a report (via PT01 signup + PT27 verify + POST /reports). Then, simulate an operator sending a message (POST /reports/{reportId}/messages). Finally, execute this item to have the citizen reply to that specific message.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 (signup) to create a user.
Execute PT27 (verify) to activate the user.
POST /reports with valid data to create a report resource.
POST /reports/{reportId}/messages with valid operator message content.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /reports/{reportId} if the resource was created; otherwise verify no resource exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the multi-step communication flow where a citizen replies to an existing operator message, covering PT18.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path test for geocoding. Send a GET request to /geocode with a valid address string (e.g., 'Piazza Castello, Turin') in the query parameter or body as per API spec. Verify that the response contains valid latitude and longitude coordinates.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of geolocation required for report creation (PT04). No auth needed per API analysis.
